corePassives.description:
When a teammate hits an enemy with their Special Attack or technique, generates multiple Ash Blades based on the number of enemies inflicted with the Haineko Mark. On hit, each Ash Blade deals damage equal to 200% of the on-field character's ATK and consumes 1 stack of Haineko Mark. 
 All characters in the team take 10% less damage. Teammates other than Rangiku gain 40% Ailment DMG Bonus.
corePassives.name: Haineko's Assist

corePassives.description: When you tap and hold the Technique button to the maximum limit, inflicts 5 extra stack(s) of Haineko Mark on the enemy.
corePassives.name: Pervading Ash

rotations.name: 2 buttons
steps: Stays off-field until Ultimate is available

skills.description: Rangiku wields Haineko to strike 5 times, dealing damage equal to 150% of ATK to the enemy ahead. The last strike inflicts 1 stack of Haineko Mark on the enemy on hit.
skills.name: Growl, Haineko

skills.description:
Rangiku turns her blade into ash, sweeps across the target area, and pulls nearby enemies, dealing damage equal to 475% of ATK and inflicting 2 stacks of Haineko Mark. ~~Channeled Attack~~ Press and hold the Technique button 
 The longer you press and hold the button, the longer the skill lasts, and the more damage it deals, up to 225% of ATK, while inflicting 3 extra stacks of Haineko Mark on the enemy.
skills.name: Like a Caged Bird

skills.description: Rangiku guides the fast-spinning Haineko to create a huge tornado, pulling enemies within a large area into it, dealing damage equal to 800% of ATK and inflicting 4 stacks of Haineko Mark on the enemy hit. After the skill is released, all teammates deal 33% more Thrust DMG for 20s.
skills.name: Neko Rinbu

skills.description: Rangiku uses Haineko to create a defensive wall to block the enemy attack and counterattack, dealing damage equal to 705% of ATK and inflicting 3 stacks of Haineko Mark.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Rangiku gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
